briefing: Markets drifted lower today (NASDAQ -0.4%, S&P500 -0.5%) on no clear catalyst — a neutral, low-conviction session. With cash at $489.29 (just under the $500 buy threshold) and 3 open slots, per past lessons we're holding rather than forcing a buy on a non-risk-on day; existing positions stay untouched and protected by automatic stop-loss/profit-target rules.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Not every day requires a trade — when the market gives a neutral signal and your available cash is below your position-sizing threshold, the disciplined move is to wait rather than force a purchase just to 'use' the cash. Chasing deployment on a low-conviction day increases risk without improving expected return.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 並非每日都需要交易——當市場訊號中性、可用現金又未達建立倉位的門檻時，較為紀律的做法是耐心等待，而非為「用盡現金」而勉強買入。在信號薄弱的日子強行進場，只會增加風險而未必提升預期回報。

market_education.summary_en: Both major indices slipped modestly today, with the S&P 500 underperforming the NASDAQ slightly, suggesting broad-based light selling rather than a sector-specific rotation. Volume and price action don't show panic — this looks like routine consolidation after recent gains rather than a shift in trend. No single catalyst stood out, which is typical of quieter, lower-conviction trading days.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日兩大指數同步小幅回落，標普500表現略遜於納指，反映市場屬廣泛性的溫和沽壓，而非個別板塊調整。成交量及價格走勢未見恐慌迹象，較似是近期升勢後的正常整固，而非趨勢逆轉。今日未見明顯單一觸發因素，屬於信號較弱的平淡交易日。
